_comment: MTOK2 scale-mode placeholder data. beta/gamma are David-decision PLACEHOLDERS (2026-08-15) — playable now, refined by ear later. A future David-authored table replaces the contents of an entry with no code change (website/js/mtok/tuning.js reads this shape as-is). If this file is absent or fails to parse, tuning.js falls back to plain alpha ratios for beta/gamma — never crashes.
_displayNames: UI labels for the scale radio (David, 2026-08-16). The internal ids stay alpha/beta/gamma/qt forever; these replace them everywhere user-facing, because alpha/beta/gamma collide with Wendy Carlos's scales. Each name is the scale's own fundamental — and all four happen to land on a programming language, which is the joke: C (alpha, JI on C3), D (beta, upper row over D/G), Go (gamma, transposed to G), Qt (24-EDO quartertones).

alpha._comment: Ratio table lives in tuning.js (ALPHA_RATIOS, canonical from MTOK_B block 6). This entry exists only to carry the display name; tuning.js does not read it.

qt._comment: 24-EDO grid is generated in tuning.js (QT_DEGREE). Display name only — tuning.js does not read this entry.

beta._comment: Only the 'hi'-suffixed pads of fqs/atri/bflsept (the SPEC's 'upper-microtonal-row') are re-tuned; every other pad (including fqs/atri/bflsept's own lo/med) stays plain alpha. Derivation: fqs-hi = G x 11/8 (undecimal over G) = 3/2 * 11/8 = 33/16. atri-hi = D x 7/4 (septimal over D) = 9/8 * 7/4 = 63/32. bflsept-hi = G x 7/4 (septimal over G), folded down one octave to stay in-register = (3/2 * 7/4) / 2 = 21/16.

gamma._comment: Every alpha pad (fixed physical position, cents-from-C3 given by its own alpha ratio) is snapped to whichever G-rooted alpha-ratio candidate (same 25 ratios, transposed to G, octave-folded into 0-1200c) lands nearest it. 'from' = which alpha ratio name supplied the new pitch; 'foldedCents' = that pitch's position in cents above C3; 'distFromOriginal' = how far the snap moved the pad from its own alpha position (cents) — flagged for David's ear pass. Sanity anchor (SPEC): eqs -> ~469c (7th partial of G, folded) -- got 470.78c via bflsept (7/4, septimal) transposed to G. Two collisions in this placeholder pass: dqfl/dqs both nearest 'fshqs' (130.2c); b/bqs both nearest 'e' (1088.3c) -- both pairs will need disambiguation once real gamma tables land.
